name: ces-migration-tools
description: Statamic 3.4 to Supabase/Next.js migration tooling for the Cambridge-Ellis School site: content extraction, asset manifest, asset upload, parity verification, fallback export and admin bootstrap. A self-contained npm project that is never installed by the deployment (the Vercel Root Directory is nextjs/), and that is retained permanently rather than being scaffolding.
//: PERMANENT, NOT SCAFFOLDING. Nothing deletes a file under tools/. upload-assets, verify-parity,
export-fallback and bootstrap-admins all run AFTER the user supplies Supabase keys; extract-statamic-content
and build-asset-manifest are retained because the content freeze can be lifted and extraction re-run against a
newer source commit, and because a reader auditing a migrated value needs the code that produced it. After the
migration these two take a path to a Statamic checkout, which is a git revision of this repository rather than
EXACT PINS ONLY - no ^, no ~, no ranges, no 'latest'. A range here would let a transitive change alter extracted
content, and a content-transformation bug is a content bug. typescript 5.9.3 and the eslint 9 line are
deliberate judgments, not staleness: TypeScript 7 is the native-port major and ESLint 10 is a major with
removals, and neither the extractor nor the lint layer is where this migration takes churn.
engines.node mirrors nextjs/.nvmrc, the single source of truth for 22.22.2. That floor is the intersection of
(^22.22.2 || ^24.15.0 || >=26.0.0), the last being binding. Do not edit it here alone.
'verify:parity' is a hard CI and runbook name contract - do not rename it.
No credential, connection string, project ref or key belongs anywhere in this file.
